summary: Quaker Chemical Corporation filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing entry into a Term Loan B Amendment to its August 1, 2019 credit agreement. The company, with Quaker Chemical B.V. as borrowers, incurred a new $550 million seven-year senior secured U.S. dollar term loan B facility, with JPMorgan Chase Bank as sole administrative agent. Proceeds repay existing U.S. Term Loans in full. Pricing is Base Rate or Term SOFR plus 1.750% (SOFR) or 0.750% (Base Rate); maturity October 1, 2033, with 0.25% quarterly amortization and excess cash flow prepayments. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
